title.narrative: Acceleration towards Malaria Elimination in Zanzibar: Programme Continuation 2018-2020 - Zanzibar (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Zanzibar, Malaria, Ministry of Health of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar (Ministry of Health, Zanzibar)This program has the following goals: To eliminate malaria in Zanzibar by 2023. The objectives of this program are: Ensure quality assured diagnosis and appropriate case management in all health facilities and community to 100% by 2023. Increase appropriate vector control measures to the population at risk of malaria to 100% by 2023. Initiate entomological surveillance in malaria foci areas from 0% of 2017 to 100% by 2023. Reinforce malaria surveillance for malaria elimination to actively investigate and classify all confirmed cases from 0% of 2017 to 100% by 2023. Strengthen coordination structures for malaria elimination at different Operational levels by 2023. Appropriate operational research undertaken to evaluate and optimize malaria intervention activities by 100% in 2023. Improve advocacy, behaviour, social communication and mobilization to general population on malaria elimination intervention by 90% in 2023
